mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ITINERARY_SHEET(itinerary_id, sheet_order, country, city, traveler_count, start_date, end_date, total_budget) VALUES (#{itineraryId}, #{sheetOrder}, #{country}, #{city}, #{travelerCount}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{totalBudget})
mapper.select: SELECT sheet_id AS sheetId, itinerary_id AS itineraryId, sheet_order AS sheetOrder, country, city, traveler_count AS travelerCount, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, total_budget AS totalBudget FROM TB_ITINERARY_SHEET WHERE itinerary_id=#{itineraryId} ORDER BY sheet_order
